description: This file defines the GalleryService class for managing gallery images, including listing, uploading, and deleting images in a Spring-based Java backend. It interacts with a Supabase backend for storage and database operations.

classes.name: GalleryService
classes.description: Service class providing gallery image management functionalities, backed by Supabase storage and database.

methods.name: listImages
methods.description: Returns a list of gallery images up to the specified limit, ordered by creation date.

methods.name: uploadAndCreate
methods.description: Uploads an image file to storage and creates a corresponding database record with metadata like alt text.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes a gallery image by ID, removing it from storage and the database.
